name: Handstand
steps: Lunge toward a clear floor space near a wall and plant your hands shoulder-width apart with fingers spread.
Kick one leg up smoothly followed by the other to stack your hips, torso, and ankles vertically over your hands.
Push tall through your shoulders, brace your abs and glutes, and keep your legs straight and pressed together.
Hold the inverted position steadily for the target duration, then lower one leg down at a time under control.
tips: Keep your ribs over your pelvis and push through your palms to maintain a long body line.
Grip the floor actively with your fingertips to make small balance corrections.
